excluded_objects.name: public.auth_migration_conflicts

deviations.source: LOGIN geno_runtime_app with weak in-SQL password and broad default grants
deviations.target: NOLOGIN geno_v2_runtime with explicit ACL only
deviations.reason: credentials belong to deployment login identities and runtime must never inherit definer powers

deviations.source: source policies default TO PUBLIC and several helpers bypass when the RLS GUC is absent
deviations.target: tenant/project authorization policies target geno_v2_runtime and require valid actor/tenant context
deviations.reason: missing request context must deny rather than expose cross-tenant rows

deviations.target: tenants uses ENABLE and FORCE RLS
deviations.reason: tenant identity rows are part of the authorization boundary

deviations.source: projects, project members, and invitations have incomplete enum checks
deviations.target: validated checks allow only canonical roles and current workflow states
deviations.reason: aliases are normalized before persistence and unknown authorization states fail closed

deviations.source: runtime_sessions allows nullable tenant and scope v1
deviations.target: tenant is required, FK-bound, and only runtime_session_scope_v2 is valid
deviations.reason: new database contains no legacy sessions

deviations.source: global audit rows have no tenant_id
deviations.target: audit rows bind project and tenant together or remain actor-scoped global rows
deviations.reason: RLS cannot replace cross-project relation integrity

deviations.source: 0030 temporarily creates NOT VALID constraints during backfill
deviations.target: fresh baseline creates every constraint validated

global_policy_exceptions.reason: pre-auth requests have no actor or tenant yet
compensating_controls: rows contain counters and expiry only
runtime ACL is limited to this table

global_policy_exceptions.reason: the kill switch is a single global read-only runtime flag
compensating_controls: only the authz owner can update the row
singleton CHECK prevents multiple control rows

runtime_identity_mapping.cutover_requirement: Compose and API database identities must inherit or SET ROLE geno_v2_runtime before compatibility can be approved

gate_execution.rule: The final Auth parity Gate runs only after both slices are installed; 0011 attaches cross-slice revocation and write-control triggers to 0010 tables.
